headline: Eager for war, and for nature writing
summary: Roosevelt tells Ambassador Jusserand he hopes America will enter the war soon, because he cannot take up arms before his country does. To Wilfred Osgood he wishes C. Hart Merriam and Edward Nelson would publish more on nature.
